Why.title: Why LabSouq?
Why.subtitle: Built for people who need to know exactly what they are buying.
Why.honestDesc: Unknown specifications, condition or prices are shown as "Not provided" — never guessed.
Why.explore3dDesc: Rotate, inspect and take apart equipment where a verified 3D model exists.
Why.bilingualDesc: Every page, product and specification in both languages.
Why.quoteDesc: Institutions can request quotations and compare supplier offers.

How.title: How it works
How.step1Desc: Browse the equipment, read what each device does and explore it in 3D.
How.step2Desc: Check quantities and estimated prices, and pick what your lab needs.
How.step3Desc: Educational institutions request a donation; other buyers request a purchase.

About.title: About us
About.lead: LabSouq is an Omani platform that gives laboratory, electronic and telecommunications equipment a second life — in the hands of students.
About.body1: Every device is listed with a clear explanation, the quantity available and an interactive 3D model, plus how students benefit from it in the lab — so educational institutions can choose what fits their courses with confidence.
About.body2: Our principle is simple: show what is known, and say clearly what is not.
About.inLabText: Hands-on learning: a teacher and students testing circuits and measuring signals on real equipment.
About.illustration: Illustration: a teacher and students running an experiment on lab equipment
About.photosSoon: Illustration — real photos from college labs will be added soon.
About.ctaTitle: Do you represent an educational institution?
About.ctaText: Browse the available equipment and choose what your lab needs.

Home.aboutTitle: Lab equipment that keeps on teaching
Home.aboutLead: LabSouq is an Omani platform that gives laboratory, electronic and telecommunications equipment a second life. Every device is listed with a clear explanation, its quantity, an interactive 3D model and how it helps students in the lab.
Home.goal1Desc: We aim to enable technical colleges, institutes and training centres to benefit from Omantel's assets by providing real devices and equipment that support hands-on experiments and connect academic knowledge with professional practice — helping develop technical skills and prepare national talent for the job market.
Home.goal1Points: Strengthening hands-on learning with real equipment.|Enabling educational institutions to develop their laboratories.|Supporting innovation and technical skills in the Sultanate of Oman.
Home.goal2Desc: We work to maximise the value of Omantel's assets by giving usable devices and equipment a new purpose — either donated to eligible educational institutions or offered for sale through clear, well-organised procedures — improving resource efficiency and supporting sustainability and social responsibility.
Home.goal2Points: Making assets available for donation according to eligibility criteria.|Providing opportunities to purchase and benefit from available equipment.|Promoting sustainability and extending the operational life of assets.
Home.goal1Subtitle: Towards applied education that builds the skills of the future
Home.goal2Subtitle: Lasting value from assets with renewed opportunities for use

Admin.loginTitle: Sign in to the control panel

Admin.reviewIntro: These workbook items were imported but their photo could not be confirmed. Check each one, choose the correct photo, complete the details, then publish.
Admin.archetypeHelp: Illustrative model of the device type shown on the device page. Choose “None” to hide 3D.
Admin.quantityReasonHelp: Recorded in the stock history, e.g. “Counted in store”.

Admin.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it changes the page link.
Admin.publishNeeds: To publish, the device needs an Arabic name, an English name and a category.
Admin.confirmArchive: Archive this device? It will disappear from the website (you can restore it later).
Admin.uploadHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
Admin.confirmRemovePhoto: Remove the photo from this device?
Admin.uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than 8 MB.
Admin.uploadBadType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are allowed.
Admin.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
Admin.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
Admin.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

Admin.usersIntro: Admins can do everything, including managing users. Editors can edit devices, stock, prices and photos.
Admin.name: Name

Admin.emailTaken: A user with this e-mail already exists.

Admin.models3dIntro: Upload a GLB file of the ACTUAL device (exported from Blender or a 3D scanner). The device page shows it instead of the illustrative model once it is published. Each part is a top-level object in the file.

Admin.noModels: No real 3D model yet. The device page uses the illustrative model of its type.
Admin.verifyConfirm: I confirm this 3D model represents this actual device.
Admin.modelEditorIntro: Name every part in Arabic and English, describe its function, and set how it moves when the device is taken apart. Leave the direction empty for automatic.
Admin.glb_NOT_GLB: This is not a GLB file.
Admin.glb_CORRUPT: The file is damaged or incomplete.
Admin.glb_EXTERNAL_REFS: The file links to external files. Export with everything embedded (GLB).
Admin.glb_TOO_COMPLEX: The model is too detailed (over 1.5 million triangles). Please simplify it.
Admin.modelTooLarge: The file is larger than 30 MB.
